purpose: Collect student-driven real poststep observation latents paired with the actual committed five-token action sequence for a later, separately frozen student fine-tuning experiment.

episode_selection.sampling_rule: Sort eligible episode IDs, remove the union of all frozen exclusions below, shuffle once with the frozen RNG, take the first 80. Using the same RNG, choose start_step uniformly from [0, ep_len - 26] for each selected episode and derive row_index from ep_offset. Verify episode_idx and step_idx by scalar metadata reads.

split.rule: first 64 and final 16 of the frozen shuffled selection, with episode identity disjointness asserted

fail_closed_if: any exclusion source is missing or has an unexpected schema/count
old ranker validation episode IDs are not a subset of the frozen reserved holdout IDs
any selected episode overlaps an exclusion or appears in both splits
fewer than 80 eligible new episode IDs remain

exclusion_sources.exclude: all 16 old real-observation diagnostic collection episodes and all 16 reserved holdout episodes
all prior ranker validation episodes; assert they are already included in reserved_holdout_tasks
all 8 untouched reserved tasks; retain them for a future independent gate
the frozen 50 closed-loop baseline episodes and the first 600 valid episodes reconstructed from ep_len >= 26 using random.Random(20300903)

episode_selection.materialized_manifest: A separate small selection manifest must record all 80 episode_idx, row_index, start_step, split, RNG seed, source exclusion counts, and overlap assertions before any environment rollout begins.

collection_protocol.policy_and_planner: Frozen 25239551 student-only native CEM; unchanged official evaluator, candidate count, top-k, iteration count, action block, and receding horizon from SEEDED_PILOT_FREEZE.json.
collection_protocol.rng_continuation: Seed once per fresh episode; preserve native solver RNG continuation from the solve at global step 0 through the solve at global step 25; do not reseed between solves.

sample_schema.z_start: float32[192], official frozen H=1 encoder of the actual pre-action pixels at the solve start
sample_schema.packed_actions: float32[5,10], formed from the 25 actual env.step actions after the exact fitted official action transform
sample_schema.poststep_latents: float32[5,192], official frozen H=1 encoder of the actual pixels after relative env steps 5,10,15,20,25

collection_protocol.action_pixel_pairing: Capture each executed raw action and its returned post-step pixels in the same env.step callback. Pack each consecutive group of five executed actions and pair it with the H=1 latent from the resulting token-boundary observation.
collection_protocol.plan_alignment_gate: For each complete sample, transformed executed packed actions must match the corresponding frozen student CEM plan with max absolute error <= 1e-5. On mismatch, fail the row and stop collection; do not train on that row.

teacher_use.official_encoder_use: Frozen H=1 image encoder only, to map actual observations into latent targets; no teacher rollout or candidate scoring.

collection_protocol.terminal_handling: Write only complete five-token rows. Mark unavailable solve windows and terminal status; do not pad, infer, replace episodes, or move IDs between splits.

sample_scale_and_cost.estimated_uncompressed_arrays: about 0.8 MB for float32 z_start/actions/poststep_latents, excluding small metadata

scope_boundary.this_freeze_authorizes: design and later collection of the frozen data tuples only
